values.note: Online reservations ran 5/18-9/13 in 2026; from 9/14 through the park's close all sites are first-come. Sites 11, 13 and 14 aren't reservable. Up to 14 nights per reservation. Call center 800-332-1501.
Map classes: S up to 20 ft, M up to 25, L up to 30, X up to 35, U over 35. S sites 4, 5, 11, 13 and 28 won't fit a 23-ft rig. Site 18 is administrative. Plus a small walk-in group site.
As the park's 2026 page has it: hot water may be limited; drinking water not yet available pending water testing, so bring your own; RV dump station not currently available.

facilities.source: https://apps.web.maine.gov/parksearch/ (park_id=7) ('Flush toilets and showers are available ... Drinking water is not yet available ... The RV dump station is not currently available'), read 2026-11-02

note: Maine's first state park, on Echo Lake ~5 mi S of Presque Isle. The park's 2026 page says it is open for primitive camping, though the 2025 site map marks electric/water sites 12, 15, 14, 17 and 30. Boat launch on the lake. --Claude
summary: Changed showers false->true, flush_toilets false->true, vault_toilets true->cleared (the May ranger statement is superseded), sites 30->28 from the map. Confirmed no potable water, no dump (both temporary), some sites FCFS. Note cleaned. Fees and season stand.
flags: HOOKUPS left as stored (electric 0, water false, derived): the park's page says 'open for primitive camping', which supports them for now, but the 2025 map marks electric+water sites 12U, 15U, 17U, 30U (reservable) and 14M (not), and fees carry a $10 electric surcharge. Nothing states whether they work. When they return, the hookups group is wrong.
SITES: map labels 28 numbered sites (no 1 or 16); stored 30 came from the note and inclusion_evidence says 30. A count of the map, not an agency statement.

UNREAD: the state's site-search refuses out of season, so per-site lengths weren't read; maine.gov/dacf/parks pages answer 403 to plain HTTP and I didn't work around it, so fee and season text stays from the earlier read.
WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' stands: the map shows sites inland of the park road and the control station, boat launch and beach, and imagery shows only the day-use lot and buildings at the shore.

PIN: stored 46.6150,-68.0095 is in unbroken canopy ~100 m W of the road; loops are invisible under trees, so I can't give corrected coordinates. Agency's point 46.615453,-68.008184 is the park building.
